title: Efficient Accessibility and Opportunities for Antibody Structural Study using Cryo-EM and Protein Engineering
content: Cryo-EM technique is rapidly advancing, enabling the high-resolution structural elucidation of various target proteins. The biggest advantage of structural analysis using Cryo-EM is the ability to obtain high-resolution electron density maps of near-native protein structures. This capability is highly useful for understanding the molecular structure of proteins and elucidating their functions. In particular, elucidating the structures of proteins under 100kDa has been considered a highly challenging area until recently [2]. However, continuous advancements in equipment performance have enabled the high-resolution structural determination of proteins under 50kDa [3]. The utility of structural information in the development of Fab-based therapies has been increasing. Cryo-EM is being utilized as a tool not only for epitope mapping through the elucidation of antibody-antigen binding structures but also for rapid screening of Ab-Ag binding structures. We have been the first domestic company to adopt Cryo-EM for structure-based drug design. In this poster, we aim to share our expertise and utilization of Cryo-EM for antibody research and provide information on analysis support services to enable more antibody researchers to engage in structural studies using Cryo-EM.
